results.name: Tax_Parcels_2025
results.title: Tax Parcels 2025
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides detailed tax parcel information for the DeKalb County GA for the year 2025. It serves as a comprehensive source of property data including land and building assessments, zoning, land use, and legal designations. The data is essential for urban planning, property management, and taxation purposes within the city.

Feature Layers

  • Tax Parcels 2025: This layer represents individual tax parcels with polygon geometries. It contains extensive attributes such as parcel identifiers, stated and calculated area measurements, zoning classifications, land use codes, and historical district designations. Financial data includes assessed and appraised values for land and buildings, aiding in fiscal analysis and property tax calculations. Legal attributes like lot numbers, building numbers, and update dates ensure precise property identification and tracking.

Geographic Coverage

The dataset covers tax parcel boundaries and associated information within the DeKalb County, Georgia, providing a geographically focused resource pertinent to local government and stakeholders.

Use Cases

  • Supporting property tax assessment and billing processes.
  • Urban planning and zoning enforcement tasks.
  • Real estate market analysis and property valuation studies.
  • Historical preservation and district management.
  • Facilitating public information access regarding property details.
results.snippet: Comprehensive tax parcel data for DeKalb County GA 2025, including property boundaries, zoning, land use, and assessed values for planning and taxation.
results.accessInformation: DeKalb County GIS Division. Data derived from county tax assessor and land records sources.
results.licenseInfo: This dataset is provided for informational purposes only. DeKalb County does not guarantee accuracy or completeness and is not liable for decisions made using this data. Users should verify information with official tax or property records.

results.name: Tax_Parcels_2022
results.title: Tax Parcels 2022
results.description:
Overview

This Feature Service provides detailed geographic and assessment information for tax parcels in DeKalb County, Georgia for the year 2022. It includes polygon features representing individual parcels with corresponding data related to property dimensions, zoning, land use, and valuation.

Feature Layer

  • Tax Parcels 2022: This layer depicts the boundaries of tax parcels across DeKalb County. Key attributes include parcel identifiers, stated and calculated area measurements, frontage and depth dimensions, zoning classifications, historical and overlay district designations, and property class information. Assessment data fields provide values for land, buildings, appraised and assessed values, supporting use in property tax analysis and real estate valuation.

Geographic Coverage

The data covers DeKalb County, located in the state of Georgia. It is suited for local government, planning agencies, surveyors, and property tax assessors working within this jurisdiction.

Use Cases

  • Property valuation and tax assessment analysis
  • Urban planning and zoning enforcement
  • Real estate market studies
  • Historical land use and district overlay research
results.snippet: Comprehensive 2022 tax parcel and property assessment data covering DeKalb County, Georgia, for use in valuation, planning, and zoning analysis.

results.name: Tax_Parcels_2024
results.title: Tax Parcels 2024
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides detailed spatial and attribute data for tax parcels within DeKalb County, Georgia, reflecting data current as of 2024. It is designed to support land use analysis, property assessment, municipal planning, and taxation tasks by delivering comprehensive parcel boundaries and associated information.

Feature Layer

  • Tax Parcels 2024: This layer contains polygon features representing individual tax parcels. Each parcel is characterized by unique identifiers and detailed property attributes including assessed values, zoning classifications, land use designations, and historical data. Additional property dimensions such as frontage, depth, and calculated area metrics are included, alongside centroid coordinates for spatial referencing. The dataset encompasses both land and building values, property class, tax district information, and notes on zoning conditions and overlay districts.

Geographic Coverage

The dataset specifically covers parcels within DeKalb County, Georgia, supporting local government and public administration needs for property taxation and planning.

Use Cases

  • Property assessment and tax calculation
  • Urban planning and zoning enforcement
  • Historical property research and record keeping
  • Geospatial analysis for development and infrastructure projects
results.snippet: Detailed 2024 parcel boundary data for DeKalb County, Georgia, including property values, zoning, and land use information to support tax assessment and planning.

results.name: Parcel_Boundaries_of_Indiana_Current
results.title: Parcel Boundaries of Indiana Current
results.description: This data layer is an Esri file geodatabase polygon feature class that contains parcel boundaries maintained by county agencies in Indiana. It was released by the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO) on February 1, 2022. The IGIO compiled the data as part of the Indiana Data Harvest program between the Indiana Geographic Information Council (IGIC) and all Indiana counties to provide the most accurate framework data for the citizens of Indiana. These layers include address points, street centerlines, land parcels, and governmental boundaries.
results.snippet:
This dataset was developed to provide accurate parcel boundaries for Indiana, as part of Indiana's annual GIS Data harvest Data Sharing Initiative (IDSI) of the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO).

If attempting to download this data in shapefile or file geodatabase format on indianamap.org, please note that this dataset is too large to fit in a shapefile and generating a geodatabase does not perform well in the ArcGIS Hub interface. To download a pre-zipped file geodatabase, please go to https://countydataharvest.in.gov/statewide/2022/DataHarvest_2022_SingleFGDB_20230125.zip.
results.accessInformation: This data set was created as part of the Indiana Geographic Information Office's GIS Data Harvest Program. The source data used to create this dataset was provided by Indiana counties.
results.licenseInfo: CREDIT - It is requested, but not required, that the Indiana GIS Data Harvest Program be cited in any products generated from this data set. If citing, the following source citation language should be included: [Parcel Boundaries of Indiana 2021: Parcel Boundaries Maintained by County Agencies in Indiana, (Indiana Geographic Information Office, File Geodatabase, Polygon Feature Class), 20220201].
results.source: Megan R.L. Compton, Indiana Office of Technology, Indiana Geographic Information Officer

results.name: Northlake_CID_Parcels
results.title: Tucker-Northlake CID Parcels
results.description:
This layer groups parcels within the Tucker-Northlake CID service area into three categories by color. 

1) Commercial property contributing to the Tucker-Northlake CID financially is green. 
2) Commercial property not contributing to the Tucker-Northlake CID financially is blue.
3) Property exempt from contributing to a CID financially is grey.

Property that is exempt from contributing to CIDs in Georgia includes religious institutions, utilities, government owned property, and all property with residential use.
results.snippet: Contributing status of parcels within Tucker-Northlake Communiuty Improvement District (CID).

results.title: 2626_baltimore_ave
results.description:
CountyParcels_DLGF_RESTRICTED is an enhanced version of County Parcel data collected from each of the 92 counties in Indiana as part of the Indiana Data Sharing Initiative (IDSI). These data include the parcel features and attributes from assessment data provided to the Department of Local Government and Finance. Please note, there may be records with duplicate parcel IDs. That will result in the DLGF information being duplicated for each record. The owner, class code, etc. will still be correct, but the value and deeded acreage fields will be for the sum of the matched numbers, not the individual polygons. IMPORTANT: All records in this dataset are completely replaced with each update. Therefore, using the "Create Layer from Selected Features" in ArcMap will not work correctly after the proceeding update, nor will definition queries based on OBJECTID.

Latest update: 11/7/2019 with 2019 polygons (GIO.COUNTY_Parcel) and 2018 pay 2019 DLGF information.
results.snippet:
CountyParcels_DLGF_RESTRICTED was created to provide state agency personnel, for internal use only, with detailed parcel information. IMPORTANT: All records in this dataset are completely replaced with each update. Therefore, using the "Create Layer from Selected Features" in ArcMap will not work correctly after the proceeding update, nor will definition queries based on OBJECTID.

Latest update: 11/7/2019 with 2019 polygons (GIO.COUNTY_Parcel) and 2018 pay 2019 DLGF information.
